holderQuote: Ceria shouted. She raised her wand, and a wall of ice shot upwards, blocking Crelers swarming from the side. Belt raised his shield.
effectQuote: The Creler’s head focused on him. It loosed another salvo. Belt vanished. Tommie ran on. He screamed, charging at the Creler. It reared up, and Ceria saw Tommie plant his feet.
